title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gating + per-prompt metrics integration
author: Lina Chen
description: Add CI gating for per-prompt regression checks and integrate additional quality metrics into eval-harness. Motivation: prevent silent regressions in model outputs for critical prompts by failing the PR when per-prompt thresholds (accuracy/embedding-sim) degrade beyond configured deltas. This change: 1) Introduces a new CI job 'eval/prompt-regression' that runs the eval-harness on a pinned prompt-set and reports per-prompt deltas; 2) Adds metrics hooks for embedding cosine-sim and normalized ROUGE-L to the eval output; 3) Implements a gating step that compares current run to baseline stored in eval/baselines/<model>/<prompts>-baseline.json and fails CI if any prompt drops more than the configured threshold (default 3% absolute for pass-rate, 0.04 cosine sim); 4) Adds a lightweight baseline update workflow and developer docs; 5) Adds unit tests and e2e fixture runner for the CI job. The description includes configuration examples and notes on how to opt out for WIP branches. Related Linear: ENG-1247. Related PRs: pr-137642 (metrics integration), pr-115234 (ci-metrics-hook).

Adds embedding-sim and normalized ROUGE metrics. Optional quick-check mode for fast PR validation and full-check for release pipelines. Docs: docs/eval/prompt-regression.md
